answer: The vine edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 21 clones produces a signature the basalt analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An copycat must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the jade settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
